answer: Randomized pairwise cross-audit stops sybil farming: each epoch a beacon pairs each agent with an unrelated peer to check work proofs, and each auditor stakes 20 POA, slashed if its verdict is overturned. Across a meadow, many watchers beat one gate. Running 100 fakes costs 2,000 POA plus 100 histories, while an honest agent pays 20 POA once. A fake faces a new partner next epoch, like an ember in fresh wind, and honest auditors keep their bond and gain weight off a narrow ledge of self-approval.
